revisions.goal: Require agent-facing snapshot completion paths to use a locked Plan reference so agents cannot bypass declare_plan by calling complete_snapshot or eve commit without planId and planRevision.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria:
- MCP complete_snapshot returns an error when planId and planRevision are omitted for a clean or allow-dirty agent snapshot.
- CLI eve commit returns an error when a staged snapshot draft omits planId and planRevision.
- Existing dirty-tree errors still take precedence when dirty completion was not explicitly allowed.
- Pending snapshot and CLI happy-path tests pass with approved plan references.
- go test ./... passes.
